text: Artonian Dobolond was the director of Project Black Harvest, which researched the exogorths for the benefit of Adascorp. He cooperated with lead scientist Gorman Vandrayk on that project.

text: Oil baths, also known as lubrication baths, were a means of removing such things as dust, dirt, and various other forms of matter that collected in a droid's joints and sockets, similar to a regular water bath for Humans. Without treatment, the debris could cause the joints to become difficult to move or lock up altogether, a condition known as dust contamination.
title: Oil bath/Legends — lead
